summary.separate_from_realized: realized P&L lives in the maturity ledger; MTM here is never counted as realized

legacy_paper_trades.note: Task 76-era prospective paper trades with state=pending_entry (signals that never entered). Shown separately; NOT merged into the active forward campaign.

eod.note: quote price equals the session daily close for matched symbols; the provider publishes no final-candle completeness flag, so completeness follows the data itself

disclaimers: Market data is delayed by approximately 15 minutes (user-observed). Displayed prices carry an earlier market timestamp, not the live exchange price.
Snapshot semantics: a price beyond a level is an OBSERVED CROSSING at the snapshot; intraperiod touches/recoveries between snapshots are invisible (observation_resolution_limited).
Open positions are neither wins nor losses; MTM is not realized P&L.
